caption: The drawing features a geometric basket shape composed of triangles and quadrilaterals inside a thin brown rectangular border, set against a cream background. The basket consists of green shapes with small darker green dots and five red triangles patterned with white and yellow vine-like floral designs. An arched green handle extends from the top left of the basket, curving upward and to the left. Within the curve of the handle, the name "Anna McBracken" is written in a cursive script. The overall layout centers the basket within the bordered square, surrounded by ample blank space.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
